lots.guide_summary: Almost all SOLD: ten per-figure eBay sold prices from PriceCharting (mostly US, 2026). Summing the lowest recent boxed sale of each figure gives US$93.32 = AUD 134; summing typical recent sales (about US$120) gives about AUD 173. One ASKING entry (US$15.99 for #1162 alone). No UNSOLD. Rate 1 USD = 1.438252 AUD. A ten-piece lot normally sells below the sum of single sales.
lots.working: Keep: sum of lowest recent boxed SOLD per figure = 5.87+11.25+6.98+4.00+5.99+6.00+7.00+8.99+9.99+27.25 = US$93.32 x 1.438252 = AUD 134.22; / 1.198 = 112.04, round down to $110. Flip: likely resale as one lot about AUD 150 (below the AUD 173 sum of typical single sales); less eBay fees about 13.4% (AUD 20.10) and outbound postage about AUD 25 for ten boxed Pops = AUD 104.90; / 2.396 = 43.78, round down to $40. Selling singly might raise more but postage per figure eats most of it.
lots.confidence_reason: All ten box numbers and names read in the photos, and SOLD prices for every figure come from an opened PriceCharting page, but they are US eBay sales (no Australian sales seen) and individual eBay listings could not be opened. Box condition only partly visible.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped the Sweets and Geeks Majin Buu #111 page: it returned HTTP 429 when I tried to open it, so its US$14.99 is unverified (lead only). Researcher's snippet-only eBay hints (US$7 to US$28, AU$125 45-piece lot) not used. Researcher's assumed 1.50 rate replaced with the live 1.438252.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1 shows all ten boxes with numbers legible. 1162 has the green 'Funko 2022 Summer Convention Limited Edition' sticker; 621 and 111 have the Special Edition sticker. Photo 3 shows a creased, dented top flap on one box (a Gohan/Goku box). Windows look intact; no protectors.
lots.condition: Boxed, appear unopened from the front. At least one box has a creased top flap; others not inspected from top, back or sides.
lots.question_for_gowans: Are all ten boxes unopened with the figures inside, and apart from the creased flap in photo 3, are there any other crushed corners, tears or sun-faded boxes?
lots.score_reason: Ten common Dragon Ball Pops worth about AUD 130 to 175 at single-sale prices; ordinary but genuine collector demand.
